privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_body: Shuffla stores login account information, brand settings, generation requests, editing results, and payment status — only what is necessary to provide the service.
privacy.s2_body: Collected information is used for user authentication, brand profile storage, card news generation and editing, work history, and payment access verification.
privacy.s3_body: We may integrate with Google OAuth, AI generation providers, file storage, and payment providers to deliver the service. Only the minimum information required to process each request is shared with third parties.
privacy.s4_body: For privacy inquiries, please email support@shuffla.ai.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1_body: Shuffla is an AI content creation tool providing brand analysis, card news generation, editing, and download. Users must review and revise generated results before use.
terms.s2_body: Users must verify the usage rights and legal compliance of brand materials, reference images, and generated results they upload. You may not use the service in ways that infringe on others' rights, privacy, trademarks, or copyrights.
terms.s3_body: The generation limits, retention period, and regeneration rights for paid plans follow the terms displayed on the pricing screen. Account permissions may change based on external payment provider approval, cancellation, or failure status.
terms.s4_body: For service and terms inquiries, please email support@shuffla.ai.
